## Summary

Hand Held Products was founded in 1981 in Charlotte, North Carolina, merged with Welch Allyn Data Collection in late 1999 and then had its headquarters in New York [2]. Honeywell agreed in October 2007 to buy the privately held Skaneateles Falls, New York, company for about 390 million dollars, and the business was to become part of Honeywell's Security Group [2][3]. Its one MA-L block is registered at 700 Visions Drive, Skaneateles Falls [1].

The company made imaging barcode scanners, rugged mobile computers, image kiosks and barcode verification devices [2][3]. A MAC in this block is most likely a Dolphin-series handheld terminal or a networked scanner used for asset tracking or supply-chain work [3]: the Dolphin 7600 terminal shipped with 802.11b/g and/or Bluetooth radios [4].

Silicon, the FCC grantee code and MAC randomization behaviour are unknown: the FCC ID databases refused this session's requests, the user manual's regulatory pages were not reachable, and nothing is filled in from memory. No advisory naming Hand Held Products hardware was found.
